en: A sepia-toned panoramic view of a mountain town in a valley with large snow-covered peaks in the background. The top of the image is labeled with the town name and valley, altitude, and the names and elevations of surrounding mountain peaks. The lower half shows dense traditional buildings and a church tower, likely the historic center, with open fields and a rail or road viaduct in the distance.
